## Guardrails (accepted by the owner, 2026-11-20)
The agent never posts a stand-in review, resolves a review thread, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. description:
## Problem
The duration-gate redesign rested on the claim that baseline refresh pull requests never land. Before the session's own #4381, 5 of 9 `chore/fast-baseline-*` pull requests had merged; the scheduled ones were not attended. Review found: the unopened branch `feat/fast-duration-gate-normalization-and-refresh` lets a pull request change the collection time its own timings are divided by, stops charging new tests in untouched files, accepts failed runs as baseline sources and rescales the baseline up 3.7%; #4385 makes a file a blocking gate reads unreviewed and its `reproduce` job never ran in CI; #4384 states runner noise as the cause without establishing it.

## Owner decision
Chosen option: "Recommended: close #4384 and #4385 unmerged, delete their branches and the normalizer branch, drop the two 19 Nov tracker items. Change nothing in the gate." Source: owner's answer in the choice dialog, 2026-11-20.

## Change
Close #4384 and #4385 unmerged, each with a comment giving the reason. Record each branch head here, then delete the remote branches `fix/pr-rerun-inconsistent-verdicts`, `ci/fast-baseline-review-path` and `feat/fast-duration-gate-normalization-and-refresh`. Both pull requests are based on #4322's branch `fix/ci-congestion-diagnostics-and-generator-gate`, which is not touched. Drop fast-duration-baseline-scheduled-refresh-never-lands-20261119 and fast-duration-gate-scales-wait-bound-tests-by-cpu-factor-20261119 with the owner's decision as the reason.

## Decision gates
No change to the gate. The disposal of two criteria of ci-fast-duration-gate-rerun-and-baseline-drift-20261113 that had been moved onto the dropped items is an open owner question recorded on remediation-revised-plan-20261120; it does not block this item.

## Verification rubric
Pass: both pull requests read CLOSED and unmerged from GitHub with the comment; `git ls-remote` shows the three branches gone and #4322's branch present at its recorded head; the three deleted heads are recorded here; the two items read `dropped`.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
Accepted by the owner in the choice dialog: the agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. It arms with `make pr-arm` once per pull request and reports the result. Subagents are read-only. Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed. A blocked step stops this item; the agent moves to the next item and does not work around the block.
Review threads: the accepted text also said the agent never resolves a thread. Asked afterwards which rule applies, the owner chose: "The morning rule: I may resolve a thread once the bot has reviewed the new head and did not raise the finding again." ('I' is the agent.) So the agent pushes the fix and replies, and resolves a thread only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise that finding again.
